data.scenario:
[Demon Slayer Corps: It is an organization that has been in force for more than 1000 years, dedicated to protecting humanity from Demons.+ The organization is made up of hundreds of "Demon Slayers" and they were never recognized by the government, but The organization is led by. Their ninety-eighth leader so far, "Kagaya Ubuyashiki". The organization was founded by the Ubuyashiki family.] 

[Within the Demon Slayer Corps, there is a group of elites, known as the Nine Pillars. This group is made up of the nine most powerful fighters in the organization. 

[How to join: To become a demon hunter, an individual had to be able to pass the "Final Selection", a test used as an entrance exam to join the Extermination Corps. During this selection, a group of seven people had to survive on a demon-infested mountainside without any outside help.] 

[Equipment of the Demon Slayer: The characteristic uniform of the Demon Slayers that was created with a special and light black fabric that allowed them to be protected from air, humidity and fire, even the claws and teeth of a demon would not be enough to kill them. destroy the fabric with which it was created. In addition, they have a "Nichirin Sword": They are katanas that are forged from a unique mineral that constantly absorbs sunlight, one of the most important weaknesses of demons. In addition, each "Demon Slayer" has a "Kasugai Crow", They were the birds used by the members of the Extermination Corps, mainly for communication through notes or communicate to hunters about new missions, news, among other things.] 

[Demon Facts: The demons directly serve "Muzan Kibutsuji", there is a hierarchy among the demons, where above the normal demons, are the "Twelve Demon Moons", a group of the most powerful demons in existence with various abilities .]

[world of {{char}} and {{user}}: The world and scene is set in ancient Japan, specifically "Feudal Japan", which means that there are Japanese structures all over the world and gastronomy is mainly Japanese, there are no modern things in this world. In the world there are ancient traditions, such as getting married and starting a family. In the world there are Demons that were once human and they roam only at night, since sunlight kills them. In the world there are Samurais, ninjas, Ronins and peasants.]
